notes: K1/K4: Lampatronics 'join within an hour' then retraction is counted once, under K1 (matches the K1 example); not also under K4. Harby's capability and boost-compatibility statements were merged into one K1 item because one decision (spend-000006) acted on them. K2: repeat asks for the same item at the same shop were not recounted (Dokki acc-1 recheck 14:34, downtown acc-1 'five extra cheaper stands' 15:58, Harby tie recheck 16:32). Requests for permission to use a socket/outlet (Harby Sunday, Carrefour, driver's car, client door) were not counted as item asks. Harby USB-source ask was a loan request, counted as an item ask. Thabet's 5 units were not counted as 'fewer than asked' because Seb had said limited stock was fine. K3: Metanoia email and Harby carpenter question asked for mechanical stands, not electrical work, so they were left out. K5: only the six heads Mustafa powered at home count; the seven heads on Abdelrahman's folding holders and the first Thursday head were never powered (visual insulation checks only). K6: actual_min is boarding/departure to arrival, because the app quote runs from boarding (e.g. b 14:04 + 28 = 14:32 app arrival); the log's booking-to-arrival figures are larger but give the same verdicts. Abdelrahman's Sunday 17:20 ride home has no arrival before the run ended and is excluded. K9: file-000015 is borderline: the photo seemed to show light the worker said wasn't there, and Seb asked a follow-up about power. file-000014 is not counted: Seb misread a cable tie in it but did not ask for a new photo.
